name: Possibly
title: Possibly | Amplifier Smart Tools
promise: Explore the experience before you build the app.
description: Start with an idea. Try different ways the app could work, choose what feels useful, and refine a clickable prototype before committing to implementation.
alt: Conceptual artwork showing an idea branching into a journal, a map, and a planner before one direction is refined.
caption: Conceptual artwork from Possibly. Different ways to approach the same task, with one direction brought forward for refinement.
flow_intro: The useful difference is how an app helps someone complete a task. Explore that before investing in the implementation.
steps: Describe the idea and what matters. Possibly generates two or three concepts organized around different ways to approach the task.
Try a large interactive preview or compare two concepts side by side. Choose the direction you want to develop.
Keep feedback and version history as the prototype evolves. Export self-contained HTML and a JSON handoff for the implementation agent.
detail_title: Make the choice with something you can try.
details: Explore whether an app should center on a session, a plan, a place, or a decision. A useful alternative changes the experience.
Compare concepts, keep drafts and feedback, and return to earlier versions while your agent helps refine the chosen direction.
Export the prototype with the brief, decisions, assumptions, and mocked behavior so implementation starts from the reviewed work.
prompt: Use Possibly to explore an app for tracking household repairs. Read possibly --help, show me different ways to approach the task, let me choose a direction, and refine a clickable prototype before implementation.
prerequisites: Python 3.12+, Git, uv, and Chromium. The usage guide includes the browser setup required for generation.
model_note: Generation needs its own configured model access. Inspecting retained work, recording choices, and exporting need no model.
